_README: PSX slow-macro manual overrides for the dashboard's Pakistan-economy tab. The scanner reads this file FIRST: a non-null value here WINS over the free fetch and over last-good. Only the macro keys below are read; _README / _sources are ignored. kse100 is also supported (optional).

_sources.reer: Real Effective Exchange Rate index (2010=100). Value below = 105.17, SBP March-2026 release (a 7.5-yr high), via Business Recorder/CEIC. SBP publishes monthly with a ~2-3 month lag; refresh from the SBP REER/NEER release or the AKD/Topline economy report (or let the auto-fetch handle it once built).
_sources.pak_ca: Current-account balance, USD million, latest month — SBP / AKD-Topline economy report.
_sources.pak_fiscal: Fiscal balance as % of GDP — AKD/Topline / Ministry of Finance.
_sources.pak_cpi: CPI YoY % — normally auto-fetched (TheGlobalEconomy); set only to correct it.
_sources.sbp_reserves: SBP FX reserves, USD billion — normally auto-fetched/last-good; set only to correct it.
